title: Deputy General Manager of Operations&Maintenance (Energy/powerplant)
desc:
MINDPICKED is a new generation recruitment firm providing companies solutions in their search for talent, and talents opportunities who wants to reach their potential.
We specialize in middle and senior management recruitment in various sectors and countless job functions.
We are looking for a
Deputy General Manager of Operations&Maintenance
for our client. Our client is one of the leading company in energy sector.
Qualifications
Graduated from Mechanical or Electrical Engineering departments of universities,
Minimum 15 years of experience in the sector (minimum 5 years of managerial experience)
Has taken an active role in power plant operation and maintenance operations and management,
Speaks English at a professional level, preferably French,
Has strong leadership and communication skills,
Has process management, project planning & management knowledge and experience,
Has no domestic and international travel barriers,
Has a good command of MS Office programs.
Job Description
To follow up the procurement of the resources required for the operation of the power plant, to ensure the most efficient use of the equipment,
To determine the activities that increase the efficiency of the power plant and to follow the practices in the field,
To follow up the opexes and to take remedial actions,
To prepare the power plant budgets and to ensure that the power plants are managed within the prepared budgets,
To follow up the power plant operations in line with the performance indicators (KPIs) determined by the Board of Directors,
Occupational health and safety in the countries where it is responsible.
